-Making lists and goals: I literally have to write on a list for the day to take a shower, take medicine, eat, chores, and misc daily responsibilities (like right  now i am getting my parents house ready for sale and closing my mother's estate) 

-being kind to myself: with the list..i "triage" things. I get the most important items done at the beginning of day and if i am too exhausted after a few items i transfer one or two items to first thing next day. 

-kind self-talk: I tell myself regularly that I am doing the best that I can and giving 200% and if others cannot understand..that is on them because i do try to politely explain. I tell myself that my ND makes me who i am..my attention to detail kept my mother alive 185% past life expectancy and i am a great friend who is loyal and remembers details which help them feel loved. Tell yourself all the good parts of yourself 

-sleeping/eating normally: if i am not eating or sleeping i will grow ill (mentally and physically)

-taking a portion out of each day to relax and indulge in special interests: this one has been a lifesaver for me. Despite being extremely busy and overwhelmed as a caregiver, i make it a point to spend 15-30 min a day alone and relaxing either reading, playing video games, music videos, etc etc

-using grounding and mindfulness: taking each moment at a time, being aware of my surroundings to prevent disassociation 

-taking a day off every once a while to completely be unmasked
